Trump Used Taxpayer Funds for Ads Praising Presidency

President Donald Trump directed the use of taxpayer money for advertisements that praised his presidency, including ads featuring the phrase ‘God Made Trump’. The use of government funds for political advertising raises questions about legal boundaries. The advertisements were part of midterm campaign efforts.
